system.description: Humans are restless, adaptable, and ambitious, at home anywhere and finished nowhere.
A bloodline of the Human ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice.

system.specialAbility: Allies within 15 feet gain a +1 Situation bonus to their first Defense roll each round while they can see or hear you.
system.description: A bloodline of the Human ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice.

A lowland order-state where nothing is real until it is written and witnessed. Serrovane settles its disputes by formal challenge, keeps its ledgers in triplicate, and considers a broken oath a more serious crime than the violence that follows it.
system.specialAbility: Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice: a language, and a Diplomacy bonus toward those who share your Culture that rises with your Proficiency Rank in your Origin.

system.description: The trade-towns of a wide river delta, where six languages meet at every dock and a good broker is worth more than a good sword. Reach folk talk first, and are very good at it.
system.specialAbility: Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice: a language, and a Diplomacy bonus toward those who share your Culture that rises with your Proficiency Rank in your Origin.
You become Trained in Athletics and in Acrobatics, and you become Trained in Lore (Circus).
system.description: In a circus or on the streets, you earned your pay by performing as an acrobat. You might have turned to adventuring when the money dried up, or simply decided to put your skills to better use.

system.specialAbility: You become Trained in Athletics and in Intimidation, and you become Trained in Lore (Warfare).
system.description: You served in somebody's army: a levy, a free company, a city watch that saw real fighting. You learned the drill, the marching, and the waiting, and you learned what a line looks like just before it breaks.

system.specialAbility: You become Trained in Guile and in Stealth, and you become Trained in Lore (Underworld).
system.description: You made your living outside the law, whether by picking pockets, running contraband, or talking your way through doors that were meant to stay shut. You still know who to ask, and which questions never to.

system.specialAbility: Sneak Attack: +1d6 precision damage vs. Off-Guard foes, rising to +2d6 at Expert, +3d6 at Master, and +4d6 at Legendary.
system.description: Grants Training in Stealth, and 2 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.

system.specialAbility: Rage ❶: Temporary Vigor equal to your level + Might, +2 melee damage, −1 Evade, and you are Heedless while it lasts. The damage rises to +4 at Expert, +6 at Master, +8 at Legendary.
system.description: Grants Training in Athletics, and 4 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.

system.specialAbility: Panache: held on a critical Strike, a Feint, or a Demoralize; +1 Situation to Evade and +1 ft to your Speeds while you hold it (Speed +2 ft at Expert, Evade +2 at Master, Speed +3 ft at Legendary).
system.description: Grants Training in Acrobatics, and 3 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.

system.specialAbility: Mark Prey ❶: +1d8 precision damage the first time each round you Hit your prey (2d8 at Expert, 3d8 at Master, 4d8 at Legendary), and you always know roughly where it is within 60 feet.
system.description: Grants Training in Awareness, and 3 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.

system.specialAbility: Drilled: Weapon Familiarity free; treat your Melee or Ranged Proficiency Bonus as 2 higher with that Weapon Group; and you may take Reactive Strike without being Expert in Melee.
system.description: Grants Training in Athletics, and 3 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.
